name: Graks
description: An orc clan in Guldark's camp who put out Pik's eyes and killed his father.

description_citations.text: "Vannemir's Choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pik explains the Graks killed his father and blinded him two years ago.
timeline.quote: They are the ones that killed my pa two years ago and put my eyes out.

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Introduction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir leaps into the camp, cuts through the Torgash and finds two chained girls, a human and an elf.
timeline.quote: until he found them, bound by chains and left in the snow, two girls, a human and an elf
